nodes.label: Network_Address_DEMO.xlsx (clean flagship workbook)
nodes.rationale: Designed to import perfectly: 63 sheets covering every sheet family (sites master, circuits incl. a retired sheet, servers, assets, certificates, services, serial inventory, 54 site sheets); preview is all creates with zero conflicts/skips/errors.

nodes.label: Network_Address_DEMO_EN.xlsx (edge-case workbook)
nodes.rationale: Deliberately messy compact English-only workbook carrying every parser edge case (headerless sheets, blank IP headers, duplicated column blocks, preamble junk, unknown sheets, empty sheet) to exercise the wizard's handling of imperfect files.

nodes.label: demo-site-cp1255.csv
nodes.rationale: Same sheet encoded as ANSI cp1255 to exercise the decoder fallback.

nodes.label: demo-addresses.csv
nodes.rationale: Flat bulk address format using the 10.130/131/132.0.0/24 prefixes the demo workbook's master list creates; requires importing Network_Address_DEMO.xlsx first.

nodes.label: demo-vlans.csv
nodes.rationale: VLAN scheme reference (vid, name, group, scope, description) that becomes a custom list documenting what the workbooks deploy.

nodes.label: demo-servers-list.csv
nodes.rationale: Mirrors a real servers-sheet export; classifies as 'servers' so the wizard also offers 'import to IPAM', and exercises every inferred column type (text key, select, multi-value ip, date, url, number, owner).

nodes.label: generate_demo_data.py
nodes.rationale: Regenerates all demo files deterministically with a fixed RNG seed and fixed workbook timestamps so every run produces identical output; requires openpyxl.
